verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a local API bundled with the desktop app and a developer portal covering chat endpoints such as create, send, stream and search. It also offers a headless CLI server for automation and scripting, a gRPC API, and an official MCP server built on that API. Together these let users and agents drive the product programmatically. The API runs on localhost, so it needs the desktop app or the headless CLI rather than a hosted endpoint. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probed doc paths returned 404), and a hosted remote API option.
